annotations.title: Text to speech: long text, up to 2,000 characters as one MP3, natural voices

description: Text to speech for a paragraph or a page: turn up to 2,000 characters of text into natural, human-sounding speech as one MP3 (base64), in English (40 voices) or Spanish (10 voices), with Deepgram Aura-2. Pick a voice by name or leave the default. Use for narration, article and summary read-outs, voice replies, IVR prompts and accessibility; for a sentence of up to 300 characters ai_speech costs less. Price $0.08/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
